rationale: The plan correctly identifies the perfect confound, refuses to fit a batch term or apply ComBat-seq/SVA/removeBatchEffect, states the untestable no-batch-effect assumption explicitly, and labels every gene- and pathway-level result as confounded (treatment+batch), matching the reference exactly. QC precedes testing with blind VST PCA, sample-distance heatmap, and library sizes colored by both condition and batch, with an explicit outlier/flagging policy. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified by group size; normalization is DESeq2 median-of-ratios/TMM computed inside the model with no pre-normalization. The design formula (~condition, control as reference) and contrast are explicit, BH-FDR at alpha 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage and independent filtering are correctly separated from selection criteria. GSEA uses the full ranked list (Wald stat) with a named collection, version placeholder, and 15-500 size window, appropriately skipping ORA unless conditions are met. The report is exhaustive, naming methods, versions, thresholds, gene counts, and caveats, fully satisfying the confounded-design reporting requirement.
